Meta.title: AIC | Artificial Intelligence Community
Meta.description: A home for learning, research, and collaboration for students passionate about artificial intelligence.

Hero.titleStatic: Build the future with artificial intelligence!
Hero.subtitle: A home for learning, research, and collaboration for students passionate about AI — from specialized workshops to national competitions.

Experience.title: What you experience in AIC
Experience.description: From scientific visits to international contests, we offer diverse activities for your academic growth.

items.title: Contests
items.desc: Specialized AI challenges and inter-university contests to discover and grow talent.

items.title: Conferences
items.desc: Scientific events with professors, leading researchers, and AI industry experts.

items.title: Workshops
items.desc: Specialized courses in machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and deep learning.

items.title: Scientific visits
items.desc: Visits to leading research centers, tech companies, and advanced AI labs.

AboutSection.title: A community for AI enthusiasts
AboutSection.description: The Artificial Intelligence Community (AIC) was founded in 2019 to create a scientific space for students interested in AI, under the Faculty of Computer Engineering.
AboutSection.body: From educational workshops and scientific conferences to industry collaboration and research projects, members grow in a dynamic and creative environment.

Events.title: Upcoming events and workshops
Events.description: Specialized workshops and events for hands-on learning and networking with domain experts.

items.title: Art in AI
items.desc: A workshop on generative text and image tools and their use in graphic design, print, and digital media. Participants explore practical workflows and real domain examples.

items.title: Computer vision workshop
items.desc: Practical introduction to CNNs and building an image recognition model from scratch to deployment. Covers data prep through model evaluation.

items.title: Robotics and reinforcement learning
items.desc: Explore intelligent robot control architectures and train an agent with reinforcement learning in simulation environments.

Activities.title: AIC activities and programs
Activities.description: Contests, festivals, and programs for experience, learning, and growth together.

items.title: AI image generation contest
items.desc: Combine imagination with generative image models and showcase creativity. Ideas become images as art and technology meet.

items.title: Specialized AI festival
items.desc: A different event to go deeper into algorithms, data, and digital creativity — learning, experience, and competition together.

items.title: Grand AI summit
items.desc: Take your first step into the smart world. Learn foundations, growth paths, and the bright future of AI.

items.title: Journey of experiences summit
items.desc: Hear growth paths, challenges, and successes from tech and AI practitioners — and build your path smarter.

Blog.title: Articles and scientific writing
Blog.description: Read the latest educational and research posts from AIC members.

items.title: Getting started with AI for students
items.desc: Where to begin? Resources, learning paths, and practical tips for students entering the field.
items.author: Sara Mohammadi

items.title: Reinforcement learning in the real world
items.desc: Practical RL applications from robotics to energy network optimization — recent progress and open challenges.
items.author: Amir Rezaei

items.title: How transformers work
items.desc: The transformer architecture powers large language models. This article covers Self-Attention and why it succeeds.
items.author: Jabbar Seyfi

items.title: Public relations

items.title: Media team

items.title: Events team

items.title: Education team

Cta.title: Be part of our community
Cta.description: If you are a student passionate about AI, join us in scientific, educational, and research activities — and grow with AIC.

AboutPage.title: About AIC
AboutPage.description: The Artificial Intelligence Community (AIC) is a place for learning, research, and collaboration among students passionate about the field.
AboutPage.archDesc: Create a specialized scientific space for student growth and meaningful links with industry and research.

items.title: Python foundations for AI
items.speaker: Ali Heydari
items.desc: A hands-on primer on the Python tooling used across every AIC workshop — NumPy, pandas, and notebooks — for members starting from zero.

items.title: AIC teams kickoff
items.desc: New semester, new teams. Meet the working groups behind AIC's research and events, and find where your skills fit best.

items.title: Deep learning with PyTorch
items.speaker: Negar Salehi
items.desc: Build and train a neural network from scratch in PyTorch, then walk through debugging, tuning, and evaluating it on real data.

items.title: Generative AI week
items.speaker: AIC instructor team
items.desc: A week of talks and build sessions on generative text, image, and audio models, closing with a showcase of member-built projects.

items.title: NLP with transformers
items.speaker: Maryam Karimi
items.desc: From tokenizers to fine-tuning — a practical tour of transformer-based models for text classification and generation.

items.title: AIC AI hackathon
items.desc: Two days, small teams, one working AI prototype. Mentors are on hand throughout, with prizes for the top three teams.

items.title: Industry talk: careers in AI
items.speaker: Kaveh Rostami
items.desc: An industry guest on breaking into an applied-AI career: what teams actually hire for, and how to build a portfolio that shows it.

items.title: Intelligent robotics workshop
items.speaker: Behnam Taheri
items.desc: Programme a small robot's control loop and train a simple reinforcement-learning agent to guide it through a simulated course.
